ranking: Eligible dual pocket-proximity, fit and severe-clash screens first; balanced ligand-contact count descending; maximum pocket distance ascending; deterministic path tie-break. No learned degradation probability. Separate all-poses and one-per-kinase lists; prospective list excludes8 current-labelled targets.
scope: Only clustered Results/combined*.pdb supplied by available runs. Unclustered Patchdock_Results are not pooled with refined clustered representatives. All incomplete/missing runs recorded; not zeros. Full-VHL rigid reference fit explicitly model-based and not a new docking/MD or proof of productive binding.
pocket_caveat: Pocket regions derived from supplied PT0/PT1 reference coordinates; proximity of any PROTAC heavy atom, not atom-mapped verification of the two cognate heads.
